name: Unload Product Enrichment for WooCommerce
author: unload

sections.description:
Unload reads your supplier invoices (PDF, Excel, CSV or image) and builds complete WooCommerce product sheets: titles, descriptions in your own tone, prices, variations (sizes, colors), barcodes and product images, then transfers them to your store in one click.

This plugin connects your WooCommerce store to your Unload account. Open it from WooCommerce → Unload, sign in, and start importing.

What it does

  • Extracts products from supplier invoices automatically.
  • Generates complete product sheets (titles, descriptions, prices, variations, images).
  • Fetches product photos from brand websites.
  • Removes photo backgrounds and standardizes your product images with the Studio.
  • Detects duplicates before publishing and restocks existing products.
  • One-click transfer to your WooCommerce catalog.

See it in action

External services

This plugin connects to the Unload service (https://unload.bot) to process your documents and create products. When you open the plugin it generates a WooCommerce REST API key (read/write) and hands it to Unload so the service can create products on your store on your behalf.

  • Data sent: your store URL, your admin email, and the generated API key.
  • Service: Unload (https://unload.bot)
  • Terms: https://unload.bot/terms | Privacy: https://unload.bot/privacy

Privacy

The plugin stores only a truncated reference to the generated API key (for display). The full key is shown once at creation and handed to Unload; it is never persisted in plaintext locally. You can revoke it anytime under WooCommerce → Settings → Advanced → REST API.

Trademarks

WooCommerce is a registered trademark of Automattic Inc. This plugin is an independent product and is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or sponsored by Automattic.

1.0.1

  • Replace the embedded admin iframe with a user-clicked button that opens Unload in a new tab (no iframe, explicit opt-in before connecting).

1.0.0

  • Initial release: connect a WooCommerce store to Unload and import products from supplier invoices.
